beats.subline: Tuesday, September 22, 2026 close — a mixed, sector-split session: chip stocks drove the Nasdaq to a second straight record while financial-sector weakness pulled the Dow lower and the S&P 500 finished essentially flat.
beats.body: Chip stocks rose roughly 2% and oil slid toward $98 a barrel on hopes for Iran diplomacy, while financials fell about 1.9% and dragged on the Dow; the S&P 500 sits just 0.4% below its all-time high as markets watched the start of Xi Jinping's state visit.

beats.headline: Trump warns UN he'll 'annihilate' Iran's regime absent a deal, signs new Arctic defense pact with Greenland
beats.body: In his UN General Assembly address Tuesday, President Trump said he faces a 'big decision' on Iran -- a deal 'right after the election' or moves to 'annihilate the Islamic Republic' -- while touting his 'Board of Peace' and defending unrestrained US AI growth; after the speech he signed an agreement with Greenland and Denmark expanding US power to defend the Arctic territory.

beats.headline: Xi Jinping arrives in Washington today for first US capital visit in a decade as Taiwan arms sale looms over summit
beats.body: Xi and wife Peng Liyuan are due at Joint Base Andrews Wednesday afternoon, with Trump personally greeting them ahead of Thursday's White House summit; Beijing is expected to press Trump to halt a pending $14 billion Taiwan arms package and existing deliveries, though Taipei says it remains confident sales will continue and Trump has called the package a useful 'negotiating chip.'

beats.headline: US and Iran hold first direct talks in months as CENTCOM reports no new strikes for 15 straight periods
beats.body: Special envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi for a three-hour, Qatar-mediated session at UN headquarters Tuesday -- the first public US-Iran contact in months -- with Araghchi repeating Iran's terms to reopen the Strait of Hormuz: lifting the naval blockade, releasing frozen assets, and ending the war on all fronts including Lebanon; CENTCOM has not announced a strike on Iranian territory for 15 consecutive operational periods.

beats.headline: Navy tests new AI-enabled mission-planning tool for autonomous strike aircraft at Gray Flag 2026
beats.body: During the Gray Flag 2026 exercise at Point Mugu Sea Range, the Navy demonstrated its Collaborative Autonomy Mission Planning (CAMP) system on an MQ-20 Avenger surrogate, letting operators build mission plans that autonomous aircraft then execute independently; officials called it a stepping stone toward fielding collaborative autonomy operationally, though no deployment date was set.

beats.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5, matching its top-tier model's performance at 40% lower cost
beats.body: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 on Tuesday, saying it matches Claude Fable 5.1 on most work while running about 40% cheaper and over 30% faster than Opus 5, with pricing at $4/$20 per million input/output tokens and a 1M-token context window; Anthropic is also raising five-hour usage limits for Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise subscribers through October 22.

beats.headline: Bears sign long snapper Scott Daly to active roster, return Nick McCloud to practice squad
beats.body: Chicago made a series of roster moves Tuesday, signing long snapper Scott Daly -- who spent the previous two seasons with the team before being let go this year -- to the active roster and bringing cornerback Nick McCloud back to the practice squad, while waiving long snapper Beau Garner and releasing offensive lineman Kyle Hergel from the practice squad.
